title: Dungeons Hedgehogs!
description: Minecraft Dungeons Hedgehogs in Minecraft! Just feed a baby pig a golden dandelion and rename it to "Hedgehog" (requires Traben's EMF mod)
body:
# Minecraft Dungeons Hedgehogs in Minecraft!
Ever wanted those cute hedgehogs from Dungeons running around your world? Thanks to the golden dandelion and mods, now you can! Just rename a baby pig of any variant "Hedgehog" and feed it a golden dandelion to stay eternally youthful.

### This requires Optifine or Traben's Entity Model Features and Entity Texture Features to work.

As a bonus, I've added Minecraft Earth's cut teacup pigs too! Same deal, just rename them "Teacup Pig".

 

- Hedgehog model and textures by Mojang.
- Teacup Pig model and textures by me.
